_doc: Reference rows `mise run triage` files as known: differences the repository already explains, so a triage lists only what is left to look at. `build` is a fragment of the build folder's name (or a synthetic skill-sweep case id), `stats` the rows it explains, `reason` where the explanation is. Synthetic case entries document sweep findings; skill-sweep does not yet consume this registry. Add an entry when a difference is documented as deliberate; remove it when the engine changes.

The imported boots explicitly grant +11% Chaos Resistance from Soul Core of Tacati, plus +53% on the item: 64%, so 386 Chaos damage becomes 138.96. The current socketable catalog and pinned PoB2 substitute +13%, giving 66% resistance and 131.24 taken. Preserve the imported item's text. Its 2162 Runic Ward, including The Brass Dome's local +991 Ward, gives ChaosMaxHit 8001 and TotalEHP 35908.717951478; the older exporter references are 2468 and 11096.445514375 (docs/maintainer-guide.md, runes and Runic Ward; the build's code.txt item 16 and item 18; base/stats.json local_ward and overlay/runes.json Soul Core of Tacati).

Virtuous Barrier counts skills requiring the Attribute, including the sceptre's Purity of Fire (Strength/Intelligence), once: 3 base + Purity + Herald of Ice + Ghost Dance + Trinity = 7 Intelligence Motes. The game stat gem_barrier_blue_grants_life_regeneration_rate_+% is 5, plus 2 from 19 quality, so the buff grants 49% increased regeneration. Pinned PoB2 excludes the item-granted Purity and grants 42%. PoBR recovery is 110.3391, reference 103.34, pinned PoB2 101.76 (docs/maintainer-guide.md, Virtuous Barrier; https://poe2db.tw/us/Virtuous_Barrier; base/skill_gems.json and base/granted_effect_stat_sets.json).

ActiveSkills.Description defines Physical Attack damage independent of weapons; game types Attack/NonWeaponAttack and no global_always_hit require accuracy. Level 20 base damage is 196–294 × 4.08, crit 5%; pinned PoB2 skips the accuracy and critical confirmation checks (docs/maintainer-guide.md, event-triggered hits). The existing 1/s presentation is not a model of blood loss, heavy stun or death events.

The hit is already calculated (level 20: 128–192 physical × 2.04); ActiveSkills.Description requires hitting a cursed enemy. Event rate is unmodelled: PoBR reports average_damage and zero DPS; PoB2 puts average hit into CombinedDPS and skips the attack accuracy check (docs/maintainer-guide.md, event-triggered hits).

The hit is already calculated (level 20: 85–128 plus 5–7 per complete 15 shield Armour, all × 2.04); ActiveSkills.Description triggers it when subsequent shield attacks deal damage. Event rate is unmodelled: PoBR reports average_damage and zero DPS; PoB2 puts average damage into CombinedDPS (docs/maintainer-guide.md, event-triggered hits).

ActiveSkills.Description requires an empowered weapon attack to hit; the 100% imbue_weapon_combust_trigger_chance_% does not supply empowered attack frequency. PoBR keeps average_damage and zero DPS with an unmodelled event rate; PoB2 puts average damage into CombinedDPS (docs/maintainer-guide.md, event-triggered hits).

ActiveSkills.Description lays caltrops during dodges and deals damage when an enemy triggers them. The game provides 3 placements at 5%/20% dodge timing, not dodge/enemy-trigger frequency. PoBR keeps average_damage and zero DPS with an unmodelled event rate; PoB2 puts average damage into CombinedDPS (docs/maintainer-guide.md, event-triggered hits).

The game Charges keyword gives a 15-second base without specifying whole-second rounding. PoBR retains fractional seconds: 3% reduced charge duration gives 14.55s; PoB2 floors each duration to 14s. The in-game tick rounding boundary has not been measured (docs/maintainer-guide.md, charge durations; https://poe2db.tw/us/Charges).
